LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlus_RareTicksPerMendModSett: Mending stands restore 1 point of durability to a contained item once per this many rare ticks.\nOne in-game hour is equal to 10 rare ticks.\nReload the save for changes to take effect.

LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlus_RemoveInteractionCells_: If enabled, mechanized and mending racks will not have interaction spots in front of them, just like vanilla outfit stands. Requires a game restart.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlus_RemoveMechanizedStands_: If enabled, mechanized outfit stands and their research project will be removed from the game. Requires a game restart.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlus_RemoveMendingStands_Too: If enabled, mending outfit stands and their research project will be removed from the game. Requires a game restart.
